name: Condrieu

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: Condrieu is made only from Viognier and is highly aromatic, with violet, white peach and apricot.
It is often full bodied and rich, with a texture like Chardonnay, and its perfume can suggest sweetness.
Too much oak can overwhelm its delicate flavors.
It is usually best within four to eight years, as its freshness fades with age.

blurb.text: A northern Rhône appellation south of Côte-Rôtie, making white wine only from Viognier. Its vineyards lie in seven communes, on the steep slopes of the foothills of the Massif Central on the right bank of the Rhône.
